Plot Registry & Capture

Draw points, lines, polygons, rectangles or circles. Each shape gets a dominant Master Plus Code at its centroid, plus the other Plus Code cells it covers. Area and line plots also require a Gate Pin — an 11-character Plus Code (~3m × 3m) marking the exact entrance, so neighboring premises sharing the same 10-character block stay distinguishable for delivery.
